purpose: SSOT for every #[ignore] attribute in the live test tree; read by scripts/gate/check_anti_ignore_gate.sh (G19).

excluded.reason: frozen historical material (archive/v3.11/archived-crates/); not a live test target and never built by CI

scope.counting_method: A literal `#[ignore` was counted only when it is a real attribute, i.e. not inside a line comment and followed by a `fn` item. Of 129 literal occurrences in scope, 31 are prose in comments/strings and 98 are attributes.

status_legend.ACTIVE: Should not be there yet: either no reason text at all, or the reason names unimplemented behaviour / a known open bug. This is the debt the ceiling bounds.
status_legend.PARKED: Reason is an external prerequisite (live server, --release, large memory, platform permission, dedicated script). Not actionable in normal development.

known_deficiencies.detail: 33 of 98 attributes carry no #[ignore = "..."] reason, which ADR-008-test-claim-transparency requires. They are registered as ACTIVE so the deficit is visible in the counts rather than hidden. Remediation is tracked as an openspec change.

counting_rule: total_allowed equals the number of entries below. The gate compares it to limits.total_allowed_max and counts entries whose status is "ACTIVE" against limits.active_max.
note_on_line_numbers: line_at_capture is a snapshot at captured_at_commit and is informational; file + test are the durable identity.
